title: COMP 3721 · Midterm
subtitle: Thu Oct 29, 11:00, 120 minutes: Lecture Notes 01 to 07 and the textbook chapters; calculator and two double-sided cheat sheets
description: The instructor's Suggested Midterm Review Topics taught from zero, one idea per short lesson: plain words first, then a tiny case, then the formula with every symbol named, then the slide's own example worked line by line, then a few exam-shaped questions. Nineteen review lessons in five groups (calculations for Weeks 1 to 3, calculations for Weeks 4 to 6, Week 7 by hand, the written-response bank, the true-or-false and fill-in bank), then the older item-by-item lessons, a 120-minute mock midterm, and the text of the four printed cheat-sheet sides.
intro:
:::quiz Midterm facts
**Thursday Oct 29 2026, 11:00, 120 minutes, on paper.** Worth **30%**; you need a **50% average across the midterm and the final** to pass the course, and there are no make-ups. Covers **Lecture Notes 01 to 07 plus the textbook chapters** (Ch 1 to 3). Bring a calculator with a log key and **two double-sided A4 or Letter cheat sheets**, handwritten or printed. The only sample of the instructor's style is the Sample Quiz Questions sheet: true or false, fill in the blanks (graded against the slide's exact words) and short written responses; expect calculations with units as in every lab quiz. The review list's own warning: Nyquist has a factor of 2 and Shannon does not.
:::

plan.title: The 50% track: lookup and plug, about two and a half hours

steps.note: 10 minutes: the exam map of the four sides and the cue table. Every true-or-false and fill-in question is a lookup if you know which side to open. Print the two PDFs double-sided now.
15 minutes: dB and SNR are on sheet side 2. Read the cue word, convert dB with 10^(dB/10), write the four lines.
15 minutes: noiseless or levels is Nyquist with the 2; noisy or SNR is Shannon without it. The picker is on side 4.
15 minutes: sampling rate, bits per sample, bit rate: one chain of multiplications in a fixed order, written out on side 3.
15 minutes: the TDM chain, unit rate to frame rate to link rate. Copy the shape from the sheet and swap the numbers.
25 minutes: one CRC division by hand beside the sheet's worked example. Skip checksum, stuffing, Hamming and Stop-and-Wait unless time is left.
20 minutes: written responses are the easiest marks. Name the thing in the slide's words from the sheet, give the reason, give an example.
40 minutes: the four banks with the printed sheets open. Practise finding each answer on paper, and pencil-mark every miss on the sheet.

Only if time is left: 1a to 1c, then 2a, 2c, 3a, 3c to 3e, 4b, 4c. In the exam: true-or-false and fill-in first and fast, then written, then calculations; never leave a calculation blank, the formula and the substituted line earn part marks.
